update.blocked-missing-key: This build has no verification key built in, so there's no in-app update — grab it from the release page
update.blocked-no-package: This release has no signed installer — grab it from the release page
update.blocked-no-signature: This release is missing its signature file, so there's no in-app update
update.blocked-portable: Portable builds update by replacing the whole folder, so there's no in-app update
update.blocked-untrusted-host: The installer or its signature isn't hosted on a trusted domain, so it won't be downloaded
update.fail-browser: The browser preview has no installer to run — test this in a packaged build
update.fail-busy: An update is already running — wait for it to finish
update.fail-channel: That release isn't on the channel you follow, so it wasn't downloaded
update.fail-config-dir: The app's config folder couldn't be found, so the install didn't start
update.fail-dev-build: A dev build doesn't run the installer — test this chain with a packaged build
update.fail-downgrade: This build is already up to date, so there's nothing to download
update.fail-generic: The update didn't complete — try again in a moment
update.fail-host: The download address isn't on a trusted domain, so it wasn't downloaded
update.fail-incomplete: This release is missing its installer or signature — grab it from the release page
update.fail-io: The installer couldn't be written to disk — check your free space
update.fail-journal: The record of this install couldn't be written, so the install didn't start
update.fail-key-invalid: The built-in verification key can't be read, so this version can't be verified
update.fail-key-missing: This build has no verification key built in — grab it from the release page
update.fail-name: A file in this release has an invalid name, so it wasn't downloaded
update.fail-not-ready: The staged installer is gone — download it again
update.fail-path: The location of the running program couldn't be resolved, so the install didn't start
update.fail-portable: Portable builds update by replacing the whole folder — in-app install isn't available here
update.fail-short: The download stopped before all the bytes arrived — try again
update.fail-sig-format: The signature file can't be read, so it wasn't verified
update.fail-sig-mismatch: The signature doesn't match the installer, so it wasn't verified
update.fail-spawn: The installer couldn't be started — a security suite may have blocked it
update.fail-tag: That version tag isn't in a valid format, so the download didn't start
update.fail-tasks-busy: A pack is still converting — wait for it to finish before installing
update.fail-version: This release's version number can't be read — grab it from the release page
update.outcome-unfinished: The update to v{{version}} didn't finish — this machine is still on v{{current}}
